pkgmetadata.longdescription: Proteus is a Rust CLI that rotates and scrubs the identifiers your Linux laptop hands out when joining a network: MAC address, DHCP options 12/60/61/81, IPv6 stable-privacy + DUID, hostname, mDNS announcements, Bluetooth alias, and TCP/ICMP stack fingerprint. Single binary, embedded wiki, no daemon — every action is a CLI invocation that ends.

use.flag: Enable Bluetooth alias + RPA support via net-wireless/bluez
Enable WPA-Enterprise / 802.1X identifier rotation via net-wireless/wpa_supplicant
Install systemd timers, services, and resume hook
